## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle commentary on the *Fànwǎng* bodhisattva-precepts by the mid-Tang Cí'ēn 慈恩 Yogācāra scholar **Zhī Zhōu** 知周 ([知周](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E5%91%A8), 668–723).

**Abstract**

Zhī Zhōu's commentary represents the third-generation Cí'ēn Yogācāra reading of the *Fànwǎng* bodhisattva-precepts. Working within the lineage of [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) Xuánzàng–[窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) Kuījī, Zhī Zhōu integrates the Yogācāra *bhūmi*-doctrine with the *Fànwǎng* precepts, treating each precept as an expression of the bodhisattva's progressive realisation of the *bhūmis*.
